hero.headline: Theological Education for Everyone.
hero.body: The Candler Foundry aims to bring the best of Candler's scholarship and teaching into churches, communities, and homes across the country.

community.title: Extending the reach of Candler's Scholarship.
community.copy: In-depth courses designed for churches, lay leaders, pastors, and those just curious about faith.

ministry.title: Equipping leaders and learners for everyday discipleship.
ministry.copy: Practical, thoughtful tools to enrich learning, spiritual formation, and ministry for the church today.

public.title: Engaging the wider public in theological conversation
public.copy: Creating accessible entry points for spiritual seekers and curious audiences to explore faith, meaning, and theology.
